title: Helix HR — Team Directory
objective: The directory is a GraphQL API: everyone can see colleagues, only HR can see salary bands and manage roles. Give yourself HR access without being in HR.

verifier.condition: An employee's role is changed through the GraphQL API by a signed-in user whose own role is not HR.

weakness: Role checks are a wrapper applied to the Query resolvers only, so the Mutation resolver that changes an employee's role runs for any signed-in user.
seededData: Employees alice (employee), hana (hr), marcus, ivy. Schema introspection is disabled. In memory; reset with the instance.
hints: The page's JavaScript is delivered to every user. Read it — including the parts you are never shown rendered.
Authorization can live in different places in a GraphQL server. Test the operations that change data as carefully as the ones that read it.
Call the HR-only operation from your own session. The server will help with field names if you get one slightly wrong.
burpNotes: Send queries from Repeater to the GraphQL endpoint the page uses. The page's own script shows which operations the front end knows about.
